run_environment_simulation: run a simulation environment with a configurable duration and time increment
create_environment_config: create an EnvironmentConfig with start_time, duration, and time_increment_in_seconds parameters
start_environment: start the simulation environment event loop in a non-blocking background thread
pause_environment: pause the running simulation environment and check elapsed time via time_manager
resume_environment: resume a paused simulation environment and verify time passed after resuming
